what: EXIT trap kill loop can abort on a raced-away PID
scenario_or_breakage: With multiple launcher PIDs, one PID can exit between copying pids and sending TERM. Under set -e, a bare failed kill exits the trap before TERM reaches remaining live launchers, leaving the orphan class this feature is meant to clean.
suggested_fix: Make each kill best-effort, for example kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true, then keep the existing best-effort wait loop.
